requirements.quote:
The client's view of the age of a ticket is the time since the
   receipt of the NewSessionTicket message.
requirements.condition: when a client computes a ticket's age
requirements.required_behavior: measure the age from receipt of the NewSessionTicket message
requirements.why_checkable: The client can store the ticket receipt time and use it as the age origin.

requirements.quote:
Clients MUST NOT attempt to
   use tickets which have ages greater than the "ticket_lifetime" value
   which was provided with the ticket.
requirements.condition: when a ticket's age is greater than its provided ticket_lifetime
requirements.why_checkable: The current age can be compared with stored ticket_lifetime before offering the ticket.

requirements.quote:
The "obfuscated_ticket_age"
   field of each PskIdentity contains an obfuscated version of the
   ticket age formed by taking the age in milliseconds and adding the
   "ticket_age_add" value that was included with the ticket (see
   Section 4.6.1), modulo 2^32.
requirements.condition: when a client forms obfuscated_ticket_age for a ticket PskIdentity
requirements.required_behavior: encode the ticket age in milliseconds plus ticket_age_add modulo 2^32
requirements.why_checkable: The field can be recomputed from stored receipt time and ticket_age_add using fixed arithmetic.

requirements.quote:
Note that the "ticket_lifetime" field in the NewSessionTicket message
   is in seconds but the "obfuscated_ticket_age" is in milliseconds.
requirements.condition: when comparing or computing ticket_lifetime and obfuscated_ticket_age
requirements.required_behavior: interpret ticket_lifetime in seconds and obfuscated_ticket_age in milliseconds
requirements.forbidden_behavior: treat the two fields as using the same unit
requirements.why_checkable: Unit conversion is directly observable in ticket age calculations.

requirements.quote:
Because ticket lifetimes are restricted to a week, 32 bits is enough
   to represent any plausible age, even in milliseconds.
requirements.required_behavior: limit the ticket lifetime to no more than one week
requirements.forbidden_behavior: set a ticket lifetime longer than one week
requirements.why_checkable: The encoded lifetime can be compared with the one-week upper bound stated by the protocol.
